title: Bouncy Tunisian Tacos
description: A flavorful and colorful twist on traditional tacos, inspired by Tunisian cuisine. This recipe combines the freshness of the Mediterranean with the vibrant flavors of Mexico.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, mix together the chopped tunisian, cooked quinoa, chopped bouncy, and olive oil. Season with cumin, smoked paprika, and a pinch of salt.
3. Warm the tacos by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
4. Assemble the tacos by spooning the tunisian-quinoa mixture onto a warmed taco, followed by your desired toppings.
6. Optional: top with diced tomatoes, shredded lettuce, or crumbled feta cheese for added flavor and texture.
